newsitem.title: HONG KONG: COSCO says 1996 performance below 1995. [CORRECTED 14:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: COSCO says 1996 performance below 1995. [CORRECTED 14:00 GMT]

text.p: COSCO Pacific Ltd's volume of cargo shipped rose in 1996 but higher costs mean the company's performance will fall short of 1995 levels, chairman Chen Zhong Biao said on Monday.
"The volume of containers shipped increased but so did costs," Chen told reporters after addressing the Hong Kong Shipowners Association. "The performance was not as good in 1996 as in 1995."
Chen did not clarify what he meant by performance. He said the company would report its results at the end of March.
The company had net profit of US$46.36 million in the year ended December 31, 1995, a 15 percent increase over the previous year. Turnover rose to US$124.08 million, a gain of 19 percent.
(Corrects denomination of profit figures to US$ from HK$)
The China-backed company, which is mainly engaged in the leasing of containers chiefly to parent China Ocean Shipping (Group) Co (COSCO), has said it is seeking to diversify its earnings base.
